standard_baseline: WCAG 2.2 AA, adapted for video-overlay graphics (SC 1.4.11 non-text contrast) and photosensitivity (SC 2.3.1 no more than 3 flashes per second).

player_message.rule: One idea, one imperative verb, no biomechanics jargon. 'Turn your shoulders sooner' not 'Initiate unit-turn earlier relative to ball-flight trigger.' The jargon lives only in coach_message_template and observed_metrics.

coach_message_template.rule: May use technical vocabulary and evidence_summary placeholders. Assumes a trained reader.

color_and_contrast.rule: Every overlay marker gets a permanent dark-on-light AND light-on-dark halo/outline (1px, 40% black or white opposite the marker fill) so it reads on both light and dark court/kit backgrounds without relying on hue alone.
color_and_contrast.color_is_never_the_only_signal: Every semantic category (measured fact, cause, correction, fault focus, confidence level) is also coded by line style (solid/dashed/dotted) and/or icon shape, per visual_grammar.json. A colorblind or grayscale-display user can read the overlay correctly.

motion_and_seizure_safety.rule: No strobing, blinking badges, or rapid color-alternation. Emphasis is done with a single smooth scale/opacity transition (150-300ms), not repetition.

reduced_motion_mode.trigger: OS-level prefers-reduced-motion, or explicit player_preferences.reduce_motion = true
reduced_motion_mode.behavior: Replace animated CORRECTION_ARROW growth and pulsing STABILITY_HALO with a single static frame at full-opacity target state. Playback speed controls remain, but no auto-playing loop is used for emphasis.

motor_accessibility.rule: All scrubber controls, phase chips, and drill CTAs are reachable one-handed in the bottom 60% of a mobile viewport and operable via switch-control/external-switch input, not gesture-only (no required pinch-zoom or long-press for core actions).
motor_accessibility.keyboard_and_switch_support: Full overlay toggle, playback, and correction-recording workflow must be operable via sequential tab/switch focus for coach-web mode.

cognitive_accessibility.rule: Player mode never shows more than one fault, one cause, one correction at a time (see scoring_profiles.json display_rules), consistent with the AUTHORING_GUIDE root-cause discipline. No countdown timers or time-pressured interactions in player mode.
cognitive_accessibility.consistent_iconography: Each overlay_marker category keeps the same shape/icon across every stroke and every session so a returning player does not need to relearn the visual language.

screen_reader_and_captions.video_captions: All coach-facing narrated walkthroughs (if voice narration is added) ship with synchronized captions; no audio-only information is ever load-bearing.
screen_reader_and_captions.chart_alt_text: Every coach-mode trend chart (radar, sparkline, reference-range band) ships a one-sentence auto-generated text summary alongside the graphic.

localization_rules.text_externalization: Every player_message, coach_message_template, drill.cue, and confidence_policy.language string is a translation key, never hardcoded English in the ontology consumer code.
localization_rules.string_expansion_budget: UI containers for player_message must tolerate 35% character expansion (Hindi/Marathi/German run longer than English) without truncation or overlap.
localization_rules.rtl_support: Layout mirrors for RTL locales; overlay marker geometry (which is video-space, not UI-space) does not mirror.
